cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I saw you stack the used plates, so I've stacked ours away too. With the dishwasher broken, we can serve the curry in rolls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stacked mine beside the sink to wash them. We've only six rolls for twelve people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the washing stack. Better still, halve the rolls: twelve edible bowls, no second stack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those halves won't hold a dinner. We still need the plates underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, bread bowls on plates. Everyone can wipe up the curry with the bowl; we'll need half the washing water.

reason: Preserve the cooperative practical correction and make final efficiency smaller and credible rather than pretending six rolls hold twelve meals.
